summary: Extend the citation to cover the beginning of the quotation in verse 24.
rationale: The supplied verse 60/24 contains both occurrences of hawo k-omər “i=aṯtáyḏi-yo”; verse 60/25 begins hul d-ko-bəṭli. The example quotes both adjacent verses, so 60/25 alone omits the beginning. The additional citation 94/326 is left as supporting evidence for ko-bəṭli.

summary: File the example about giving up the search under sense 1.
rationale: The example baṭəl b-u=šiyolo ʕal i=barṯo is translated “er gab das Nachforschen nach seiner Tochter auf”. This describes ceasing the search, matching sense 1 “aufhören, zum Stillstand kommen”, rather than sense 2 “müde werden”.
